title: A Preemptive and Curative Solution to Mitigate Data Breaches: Corporate Social Responsibility as a Double Layer of Protection
eligible_reason: No eligible DiD. Study 1 is a firm-year breach-likelihood model with continuous CSR scores; Study 2a is a stock-return event study (CAR) and Study 2b a Tobin's q regression with breach x CSR interactions, industry (not firm) fixed effects, many time-varying controls and a 2SLS estimator. Breaches recur and CSR is continuous, so there is no absorbing binary adoption.
design_notes: KLD CSR scores merged to Compustat; 20,700 firm-years. Table 5: fixed-effects 2SLS of Tobin's q on Data Breach(t-1) and interactions with internal/external CSR and high-CSR dummies, industry and year indicators, Compustat controls. Authors state they use industry fixed effects instead of firm fixed effects.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Data are KLD and Compustat (licensed). Excluded for IV, continuous treatment, interactions, controls and no unit FE.
